verdict.rationale: Pipedrive's own feature page claims revenue forecasting, so the capability is first-party. That claim is a single glancing marketing line with no detail on how forecasts are built. missing for 10: documentation that forecasts use pipeline deal value, stage probability weighting, and expected close dates; forecast views or reports; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can forecast revenue from pipeline value, stage probabilities, and close dates

citations.quote: Lead scoring automation, automatic lead assignment and revenue forecasting? Check.
